as_of_contract: Day D features use only edges with date < D. The snapshot is updated after day D is written, so a row never sees itself or any same-day edge.
usd_rule: amount_usd computed from eda_output/fx_usd_rate.csv (fiat) and eda_output/fx_btc_daily_rate.csv (Bitcoin); fx_pair_rates.csv never used.

deviations.implemented: (from_account, to_account) - amount not in the key
deviations.reason: docs/data_contract.md section 6.2 measured repeats as padding; including amount in the key would count padding as new relationships.
deviations.impact: fan/velocity counts are distinct counterparties, an upper bound on distinct amount-pairs.

deviations.detail: Was byte-identical to from_fan_out (corr 1.0, equal arrays) because the snapshot is already as-of. Dropped to avoid duplicate signal.
from_fan_ratio/to_fan_ratio are derivable from fan_in/fan_out and were left out of the model table; compute them downstream if a ratio is wanted.
from_min_gap_seconds/to_min_gap_seconds added after the fact: cache gained ts_ns (CACHE_VERSION 2) so gaps are true timestamp gaps, floored at 60 s.

findings.finding: 41,815 distinct banks in the full file; bank codes are uint16, not uint8.

No within-window signal beyond the day effect. Whole-period bins show a spurious 1,149x lift in the excluded 09-11..09-17 tail (whole-file aggregate leakage, rule 4). Within 09-02..09-10 per-day lift swings 0.64x-2.05x with no monotonic age trend; median age is constant at 1-2 days for most days.

Median 60 s - the floor binds for over half the rows, so the feature behaves as a "acted within a minute of prior activity" flag rather than a continuous gap. -1 marks an account with fewer than two prior edges.

features.name: from_txn_count
features.definition: [from] Edges touching the account strictly before the current day, both directions.
features.as_of_rule: snapshot folded forward after the day is written; only days strictly before this day contribute
features.null_policy: never null; 0 when undefined (-1 for *_age_days and *_min_gap_seconds)
